package.name: phpcs
package.title: PHP CodeSniffer
package.description: The PHP CodeSniffer platform: the `@phpcs:*` tag family understood by PHP CodeSniffer.

tag.name: codingStandards
tag.summary: The `@codingStandards` tag names a coding standard for reference.

tag.name: codingStandardsIgnoreEnd
tag.summary: The `@codingStandardsIgnoreEnd` tag ends a block of code started by `@codingStandardsIgnoreStart`, resuming coding-standard checks from this point on.

tag.name: codingStandardsIgnoreFile
tag.summary: The `@codingStandardsIgnoreFile` tag ignores the whole file for coding-standard checks.

tag.name: codingStandardsIgnoreLine
tag.summary: The `@codingStandardsIgnoreLine` tag ignores a single line of code for coding-standard checks.

tag.name: codingStandardsIgnoreStart
tag.summary: The `@codingStandardsIgnoreStart` tag starts a block of code excluded from coding-standard checks, closed by a matching `@codingStandardsIgnoreEnd`.
tag.description: The `@codingstandardsignorestart` tag starts a block of code excluded from coding-standard checks, closed by a matching `@codingStandardsIgnoreEnd`.

tag.name: phpcsSuppress
tag.summary: The `@phpcsSuppress` tag suppresses the named coding-standard check for the element it decorates.
